description: Link one control to its signed-off procedure document, or null to unlink (write — editor+). The document must be this org's procedure, approved or published when linked (400 otherwise).

document_id.description: Procedure document UUID — obtain from scf_list_documents; null unlinks. A later edit sends the document back to review; the link stays and scf_list_scoped_controls shows procedure_document_status

scf_id.description: SCF control identifier in DOMAIN-NN format — obtain from scf_list_scoped_controls

name: scf_set_control_procedure
